instruction: Set up a new folder on the Chrome bookmarks bar and label it 'Resources'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a bookmark folder named 'Resources' on the bookmarks bar. Uses existing Chrome evaluator functions (is_expected_bookmarks with bookmark_bar_folders_names type). No custom functions needed - reuses official getter/metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads Chrome bookmarks file from OS-specific path and extracts full bookmark hierarchy
Metric correctly filters bookmark_bar folders by type and verifies "Resources" exists using subset check
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what instruction requires (folder named Resources on bookmark bar)
Expected value is semantically correct: ["Resources"] matches instruction requirement
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure bookmark changes are persisted to disk
Runtime feasibility: no complex dependencies, file-based getter works reliably
Subset check allows additional folders to exist, which is correct behavior (instruction only requires creating Resources, not exclusivity)
